generationHistory.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / style-transfer.
Asset: replacement illustration for "Lord Tibo's Reset", La Rata Remix game card. Full bleed landscape 4:3, ideally1448x1086, opaque RGB, no words, title, card frame, UI or watermark.

INPUT ROLES:
Image1 is the USER-SUPPLIED PHOTO OF TIBO, the mandatory identity/face reference. Transform this real man into a HUMAN fantasy character while retaining his recognizability: short slightly tousled dark brown hair and hairline, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm eyes, long straight nose, subtle jaw stubble, light skin, broad friendly toothy smile, natural head shape and slight relaxed head tilt. Keep him a youthful adult man. Do not substitute a generic handsome wizard or rat.
Image2 is the PREVIOUS RESET CARD ILLUSTRATION: composition/palette/ancient reset mechanism reference ONLY. Replace its rat character COMPLETELY with the human from image1. No rat muzzle, whiskers, animal ears, fur, paws, tail or animal companion.
Image3 is a mod-owned LA RATA CARD STYLE REFERENCE: rich dark fantasy painting, sculpted color planes, broad decisive brushwork and contours, vibrant readable light. It contributes style only, no vehicle, creature or thorns.

SCENE AND ACTION:
Expand the human photo into a three-quarter waist-up action portrait in a ruined royal Spire chamber. Tibo occupies the center/right and retains the reference's warm recognizable smile. Dress him in a simple charcoal fantasy tunic with a burgundy cloak and restrained gold/emerald clasp, preserving a dark clothing silhouette. Hair and face fully visible. He presses a large physical RESET BUTTON on an ancient stone-and-brass pedestal in the foreground left. His connected human forearm and palm firmly press down the circular button cap, visibly depressed beneath its rim. Button carries a single clean circular return-arrow symbol, with NO lettering.
Add MANY DISTINCT FLOATING ENERGY BALLS ALL AROUND HIM, across foreground, both sides, upper background and near his free hand. They are clearly round magical orbs with glowing amber/gold cores and broad warm halos, a variety of sizes and depths, linked by a few curved energy trails into the reset-button pulse. Some smaller emerald/gold accents, but not blue star shapes. Keep the face and pressing hand unobscured and make the button contact clear. A magical energy-recall burst at the pressure point powers the orbs. Cool indigo/plum stone and deep shadow contrast with warm golden energy.

STYLE:
Completely repaint ALL pixels, especially the face, into the established Slay the Spire2 / La Rata card-art language. Human likeness should remain immediately recognizable from the photo, but rendered as a coherent stylized game illustration with expressive simplified facial planes, strong dark edges, chunky brushwork and painted light. No pasted photographic face, photoreal skin, airbrushed glamour, anime, glossy 3D or generic caricature. Character, orbs, button and architecture share one painted style. Keep key face/button/hand within central85% for native rounded card crop. No animal features at all.
